notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Feldon.
Feldon does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Atsushi with haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Atsushi token, adding {R}.
Atsushi dies, triggering itself and Feldon.
Resolve the Atsushi trigger, creating three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Feldon trigger, untapping it.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead exile cards using Atsushi and cast them from exile this turn.
